resources.string: Acceleration and proxy for Perfect Git
Only Perfect Git synchronization uses these settings. Other app connections and system network settings stay unchanged. HTTPS certificate validation stays enabled.

Leave blank for the original repository. Use an HTTPS prefix, an HTTPS template containing {url}, or a full HTTPS Git repository address. You can replace the address. The service must support Git smart HTTP and filter; download-only mirrors do not work.
Enter a host name or IP address and a port from 1 to 65535. Credentials are not supported.
Check the HTTPS address and proxy host and port.
